items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1966-03-09
items.q: Yeah I worked with Talbert a long time. I worked with him, yes.

ctx.x: Do you remember when you played with Elmer Talbert? Did you ever work with him?

Yeah I worked with Talbert a long time. I worked with him, yes. He was a pretty nice trumpet player. Talking about, what's his name, Kukie? He lived at Dumaine and Claiborne there, Talbert. What's his other name? Kukie. Kukie. Kukie. Yeah. He's got a son now in California. He's dead two years ago. Yeah, yeah. I heard that he died. But you were in Philadelphia I guess.
A lot of those sons died. Yeah, yeah. How long were you in Philadelphia?
